title: Client for the Comprehensive Knowledge Archive Network (CKAN) API
text: CKAN open-source DMS (data management system) data hubs data portals. Users publish, share use data CKAN. powers hundreds data portals worldwide. ckanr works CKAN websites. Users create, modify, manage datasets. Users search download existing data. Users analyze data R (stats/plotting/etc.). works CKAN instance. ckanr works tested - CKAN v2.11 API, - CKAN v2.10 API, - CKAN v2.9 API. ckanr can work older newer CKAN versions. Get started: https://docs.ropensci.org/ckanr/
